reason: For the wedding repaint I'll just call our family painter. He has done this house for years, knows every damp patch, and uses Asian Paints, so nobody at home has to deal with strangers. The daily WhatsApp photos and pay-after-checking are nice for someone like me who isn't always around, but they aren't enough to drop someone we trust.
objection: I have never heard of Turbolux. With relatives coming for the wedding I can't risk the walls looking patchy or peeling in a year with a brand nobody I know has used, and a 3-year guarantee from a company new to Kochi only means something if they're still around.
would_change_my_mind: If our painter can't fit us in before the wedding, or if I could walk through a finished Turbolux home in Kochi and hear from the owners that it held up through a monsoon.
